effect: Private capital inflows fade smoothly as a country's rating worsens instead of stopping at notch 17. For a country with net private inflows (privateFinancingPct > 0), inflows are scaled by L(rating) / L(day-0 rating), with L(r) = 1 / (1 + exp((r - 16.5) / 1.5)), capped at 1.5x for upgrades; the day-0 rating is stored in the game's own day-0 external-financing record (externalFinancing0.geobalRating0) at genesis right after the game sets the day-0 rating (EYQ, both genesis paths), and backfilled on the monthly reserve pass (F6Q) for saves made without the mod; inflows only read it, so views never write state. A downgrade from 14 to 17 now cuts inflows by about half (the original rule: from all to nothing at 17). Countries that start at rating 17 or worse (no market access at day 0), defaulted countries and net-outflow countries keep the original rule; the market-access gate on rollover and bond issuance (Ni) is unchanged. Not included: the real-interest-rate gap. Day 0 unchanged (factor 1 at the day-0 rating). (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
